verdict: Prismatic Evolutions is holding value better: PRIS25 98.04 vs AH26 93.88 since the Aug 24 launch at 100.00 (Sep 21 mark); PRIS25 was the only one of the two up in the latest week (+1.3% vs −3.1%, AH26's third straight weekly fall). Ascended Heroes has the deeper chase list (top three sold-comp medians sum $2,232.00 vs $1,788.53; Pikachu ex SIR $877.00, Mega Gengar ex SIR $855.00, Mega Dragonite ex SIR $500.00) though Umbreon ex SIR $1,069.03 is still the single biggest card (30-sale medians read Sep 27). Prismatic Evolutions is the cheaper ETB (lowest ask $134.99 vs $158.99, Sep 27); booster bundles tie at $74.99.
